prompt: Extract data from this text: "Mara Lindqvist, who turned 34 last month, moved to Oslo in 2021 and works as a nurse." Use exactly these keys: name (string), age (integer), city (string), move_year (integer), job (string, lowercase). Reply with only a JSON object and nothing else.

Extract data from this text: "Order #4471 was shipped to Berlin by DHL. No tracking number was provided." Use exactly these keys: order_id (integer), city (string), carrier (string), tracking_number (string, or null if not given). Reply with only a JSON object and nothing else.

Extract data from this text: "The Alvarez family: parents Rosa (41) and Tomas (43), children Lucia (9) and Mateo (6)." Use exactly this shape: {"family": string, "parents": [{"name": string, "age": integer}], "children": [{"name": string, "age": integer}]}. Keep people in the order they appear. Reply with only a JSON object and nothing else.

A receipt lists 3 notebooks at $2.50 each, 2 pens at $1.20 each, and 1 bag at $18.00. Sales tax is 10% of the subtotal. Return exactly these keys as numbers (not strings), rounded to 2 decimal places: subtotal, tax, total. Reply with only a JSON object and nothing else.

Extract data from this text: "The meeting is on the 3rd of March 2027, starts at quarter past four in the afternoon, and lasts 90 minutes." Use exactly these keys: date (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD), start_time (24-hour HH:MM), duration_minutes (integer), end_time (24-hour HH:MM). Reply with only a JSON object and nothing else.

Classify the sentiment of each review as exactly one of: positive, neutral, negative. Reviews: 1) "Loved it, will buy again!" 2) "It arrived on Tuesday." 3) "Broke after two days, total waste." Use exactly this shape: {"results": [{"id": integer, "sentiment": string}]}, in review order. Reply with only a JSON object and nothing else.

Here is a list of tags: "python, data, Python, ml, data, sql, ML". Return them lowercased, with duplicates removed, and sorted alphabetically, as {"tags": [...]}. Reply with only a JSON object and nothing else.

Return a JSON object with exactly one key, "command", whose string value is exactly this text (including the quote marks and backslashes): He typed "dir" in C:\temp\logs Reply with only a JSON object and nothing else.

Extract data from this text: "Flight LH 402 departs Frankfurt at 07:45 and arrives in Lisbon at 09:30 local time. Lisbon is one hour behind Frankfurt. The aircraft carries 168 passengers and 6 crew." Use exactly these keys: flight (string, exactly as written), duration_minutes (integer, the real elapsed flight time), passengers (integer). Reply with only a JSON object and nothing else.

Extract data from this text: "Team roster: Ana (goalkeeper), Ben (defender), Chen (no position yet), Dara (striker)." Use exactly this shape: {"players": [{"name": string, "position": string or null}], "count": integer}. Use null when no position is given, and keep the order of appearance. Reply with only a JSON object and nothing else.
